newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise confirms Suez bid plan.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise confirms Suez bid plan.

text.p: Lyonnaise des Eaux chairman Jerome Monod confirmed on Friday that the giant utility group planned to acquire conglomerate Cie de Suez through a merger-takeover.

Monod told Europe 1 radio that the combined group would have some 200 billion francs ($34.5 billion) in annual turnover and would have "the resources to invest" around 17 billion francs from the first year.
The boards of the two companies are meeting on Friday to approve terms of the link-up, which has already received the backing of the Lyonnaise board.

Suez and utilities group Lyonnaise des Eaux were due later on Friday to announce more details of the merger deal that effectively ends the independence of Suez which was set up in the 19th century to build the Suez Canal.
